THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MCLEAN, CHRISTOPHER RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT DAVIS-PAUL MANAGEMENT GROUP $586.00 PRINCIPAL, $90.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $676.00, *** DEFENDANTS WITHHELD $293.00 FOR REPAINTING APARTMENT DESPITE THE FACT THAT PLAINTIFF HAD RESIDED THERE 3 YEARS, AND THE UNIT HAD NOT BEEN REPAINTED BEFORE PLAINTIFF MOVED IN. PAUL ARE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE; DEFENDANT, DAVIS-PAUL MANAGEMENT GROUP IS ADDED AND IS ORDERED TO PAY THE JUDGMENT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
